user.title: Where is your garden?
user.description: Your ZIP code is used to look up your USDA hardiness zone (from phzmapi.org) and estimate your frost dates.

frost.title: Your climate
frost.description: {source} Every sowing, pruning and harvest date is counted from these two dates. Correct them if you know your local averages; only the month and day are used.

error.unknown_zip: No hardiness zone found for this ZIP code.
error.cannot_connect: The zone lookup failed. Check your connection and try again.
error.frost_order: The last spring frost must come before the first autumn frost.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Master Gardener is already set up.

data.use_station: Use the weather station's frost dates

data_description.weather_entity: Optional. Its forecast holds off watering when rain is coming and warns when frost or heat threatens what you have planted.
data_description.annual_budget: Optional. What you mean to spend on plants and projects each year. The build plan spreads planned purchases over the years to stay within it. Leave empty for no limit.
data_description.use_station: Replaces the two dates above with the station's averages.
data_description.seed_inventory: Optional. A Simple Inventory inventory that holds your seed (pick its inventory sensor). Each sowing then says what seed you have, and a "Get seed" task comes six weeks ahead of any sowing you have no seed for.

user.title: Add plantings
user.description: Record plants that are already growing. Each gets the upkeep tasks for its kind, and the weather and soil alerts count it. To plan something you have not bought yet, ask your gardener agent or use the Add planting action with status planned.

data_description.plants: One per line, as you call it: hosta, japanese maple, Cherokee Purple tomato. Start a line with a number for several, e.g. 3 hosta.
data_description.when: Annuals always count as planted this season unless you give a date.

match.title: Which plants do you mean?
match.description: These names match more than one plant in the catalogue, or none exactly. Pick the one you have. A plant kept as typed is tracked without catalogue dates.

error.too_many_plants: Enter at most 50 plants at a time.
error.date_needed: Pick the date they were planted.

abort.catalogue_not_ready: The plant catalogue is still downloading. Try again in a few minutes.
abort.not_loaded: Master Gardener is not running. Reload it and try again.

died.title: {name} died
died.description: It stays in the history, so later advice does not repeat the mistake.
